0022600088.text: Both the Chicago Bulls and Toronto Raptors open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, which is the first of the season for the Bulls, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Chicago a 25% chance to win. Chicago is without Nic Claxton, who is day-to-day with a hamstring injury, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, and is also without Chucky Hepburn and Nate Bittle, who are day-to-day with hamstring and foot injuries. In 2025-26 the Bulls lost 0-3 to the Raptors, including a 139-109 defeat in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
